themes.description: Concerns or feedback related to specific trading tools, indicators, or functionalities within the platform, including their presence or absence.
Requests or feedback related to the availability of new investment products, asset classes, or foreign investment opportunities.
Problems related to downloading, installing, logging in, or generally accessing the application.
Issues or feedback related to the account creation process, KYC requirements, verification steps, or initial setup.
This theme covers suggestions for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or requests for additional data and reporting capabilities within the application.
This theme covers issues related to the application's ease of use, clarity of information, intuitive design, and overall user experience.
This theme covers issues related to account opening, activation, verification, KYC, profile updates, and general account status.
This theme covers issues related to the app's user interface, user experience, display problems, layout, and device compatibility.
This theme covers feedback related to the relevance, frequency, and impact of in-app notifications and advertisements on user experience.
This theme covers feedback related to the presence, absence, or functionality of specific features within the application.
Issues related to mutual fund (SIP) management, unauthorized investment actions, and incorrect portfolio or balance displays.
Overall satisfaction or dissatisfaction with the application's design, usability, and general functionality.
This theme covers feedback, both positive and negative, related to the core product offerings, specific features, and their functionality or value.
This theme captures general sentiment, positive or negative, about the application or service that isn't specific to a particular functional area or feature.
Issues and suggestions related to charting functionalities, drawing tools, indicators, and technical analysis features.
Suggestions for new features, enhancements to existing functionalities, or requests for additional data and tools.
General positive comments, appreciation for the app, or expressions of satisfaction.
This theme covers feedback related to the frequency, duration, and impact of app updates, including interface changes and user experience disruptions caused by updates.
Issues related to identity verification, KYC, PAN/Aadhar validation, and account setup processes.
This theme covers concerns related to company trustworthiness, ethical practices, perceived fraud, and general integrity.
Covers problems related to account balances, missing funds, incorrect portfolio displays, or account access.
Covers feedback related to the overall ease of use, intuitiveness, and satisfaction with the application's design and functionality.
Covers reviews expressing suspicion of fraudulent activity, lack of transparency, or illegal practices by the company.
Addresses concerns related to personal data leakage, unauthorized access, privacy breaches, and overall security of user information.
Covers feedback related to the application's dependability, trustworthiness, and general positive sentiment regarding its operation.
This theme covers feedback related to the application's user interface, layout, navigation, and overall user experience design choices.
